description: Sets the company's business address. After the state is set, read lovie_mailbox_available from formation_get_formation. When it is true, present BOTH options: source = ADDRESS_SOURCE_OWN with their own address, which may be anywhere in the world, or source = ADDRESS_SOURCE_NEED_ASSISTANCE for Lovie's virtual mailbox in that state (a real US address Lovie provides); offer the mailbox whenever the user has no address or prefers not to use a home/personal one. When it is false, say Lovie's mailbox is not offered in that state and offer their own address or skipping for now; NEED_ASSISTANCE is refused there. A skipped address is still required before payment. Every address needs a street, city, and ISO country code; a US address also needs its state and a 5-digit ZIP.
name: formation_set_company_address
title: Set Company Address
